description: This file contains Jest tests for utility functions related to tenant management in a frontend application, including tests for normalization, fetching session tenants, selecting tenants, and setting active tenants.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes various tenant ID formats to a string or null.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches tenant session items from the server.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Selects a tenant, updates local storage, and makes an API call.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Sets the active tenant in local storage and removes legacy key.
